inv.desc_en:
1. Regulations and Urban Planning Parameters for the industrial unit located on Calle Gramil
Setbacks:
Front: 6.00 m
Sides and rear: 5.00 m
Urban Planning Limits:

Maximum occupancy: 806.10 m2

Maximum buildable area: 1,209. 15 m2 (reaching up to 1,735. 35 m2 according to the plot data sheet)

2. Current Areas
Ground floor: 713.00 m2

Offices (mezzanine): 50.00 m2

Total built area: 763.00 m2

3. Features and Equipment
Condition: Excellent state of repair, ready for immediate use.

Utilities: Utilities connected.
Protection: Fire protection system installed.
Loading and Unloading: 3 loading docks located on the side of the unit.
Accessibility: Ample space at the front and sides, ideal for vehicle parking and truck/trailer maneuvering.
Agency Fees: 1.5% plus VAT of the final sale price to be paid by the Buyer.
